title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a fiery Turn On Your Love Light performance with stellar Pigpen energy.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clear, well‑balanced soundboard tape that showcases one of the early ’70 Dead’s most celebrated moments – a ripping Turn On Your Love Light led by Pigpen. While one reviewer felt the band was sluggish, the consensus praises the wild improvisations, tight harmonies and overall punch of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted both superb playing and excellent recording; only one moderate 3‑star review tempers the average but does not outweigh the strong consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear for the era with a well‑balanced mix; occasional feedback and minor spacing issues noted, but overall crisp sound and faithful capture of the band’s dynamics.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds into a high‑energy Turn On Your Love Light that drives the second half, featuring wild Pigpen antics and an unexpected Zeppelin‑style jam; despite a few sloppy moments early on, the performance gains momentum and ends on a powerful note.
